change_summary: Ask for the place name at city level, not street level.
reason: Three audit findings show street names let people be identified, so the rule needs a city-level wording.
expected_flips: Posts naming a street would be held, not published.
rollback_plan: Revert to the previous pack version.
who_is_affected: Everyone posting a first problem in one region.
lawful_basis: The pack's own privacy rule, no outside basis claimed.
risks: Some real problems may be held back at first.
